claims.assertion: Anéeka recalls living independently at 12–13 in a child-sized seaside house, with broad information access and freedom to study.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: She says Taygetan orphans learn self-reliance early under non-invasive supervision and receive homes scaled to their age.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Anéeka says she serves as her people’s ambassador to humanity; aboard CIC she monitors ship status, reports and other cultures’ orbital communications.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Her routine includes exercise, meditation, shared meal duties, socializing, play with Yazhi and self-directed study.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
